title: The Industry Disruptor
description: High-energy, broad-appeal video designed for maximum reach. Built on a trending audio hook with fast-paced editing to trigger the discovery algorithm.

title: Coffee & Q&A
description: A low-production, 'face-to-camera' video addressing specific follower questions. Designed to deepen trust and drive comments from existing fans.

title: The Product Deep-Dive
description: A polished showcase of features and benefits. While reach is lower, it focuses on high intent and conversion-ready saves.

title: Late Night Musings
description: Experimental content that failed to find an audience. High skip rates indicate a weak hook or misalignment with the platform's core demographic.

title: The Hot Take
description: A controversial opinion on industry standards. Drives massive comment volume and shares, but results in high 'unfollow' rates due to its divisive nature.

title: Masterclass: Step-by-Step
description: High-value tutorial content. It experiences slow initial growth but maintains a steady long-tail view count because it is highly searchable and saved.
